page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top. No margin notes. Below the text, nothing printed except the final word "Sunt" set at the right.

main_text.head: RODOLPHI GOCLENII MEDICI DOCTORIS. RAPHAELIS EGLINI LEONTI TIGURINI, SS. Theologiæ Doctoris, & Professoris Ordinarii in inclyta Academia Marpurgensi, Carmen.
main_text.p: Aurea debetur duplici tibi nomine Phæbe, Quòd tua testudo est, quòd Medicina tua est.

p.i: Herbarum inde tibi divina potentia seruit; Inde genus Vatum surgit & ordo tibi. Scilicet hinc ex te, Nymphaq; Coronide, nato Delubrum veluti constituere Deo. Fallor an ambigua est Graiorum fabula? Nostris Debetur potius temporibusq; fides? Ecce parens Vatum GOCLENIVS ille RODOLPHVS, Ecce RODOLPHVS item filius ille Patris,

page.notes: The first word of the lower lines is printed in a larger italic initial "L" in the opening line, read as "Aurea" with the L as an enlarged initial. The page is a little faded; the faint show-through from the reverse side and the small hand-stamp marks at the right margin are not transcribed. Some words in the Latin verse are partly obscured by show-through and were read with best effort.
